红灯停，黄灯等，绿灯行；绿灯亮时也要先看左右再通过: Red means stop, yellow means wait, green means go; even on green, look left and right first
过马路走斑马线（人行横道），没有斑马线时走到视线好的地方，确认没有车再过: Cross at the zebra crossing (pedestrian crossing); where there is none, go to a spot with a clear view and cross only when no vehicle is coming
过马路不跑、不追逐打闹、不看手机、不戴耳机听音乐: When crossing, do not run, chase or fool around, look at a phone or listen to music with headphones
靠右边走；有人行道走人行道，没有人行道靠路边走: Keep to the right; use the pavement where there is one, and the roadside where there is not
不要突然从停放的车辆或障碍物后面跑出来，司机看不见你: Do not dash out suddenly from behind parked vehicles or obstacles: drivers cannot see you
公交车、大货车附近有视线盲区，不要在车前车后穿行: Buses and large lorries have blind spots; do not walk in front of or behind them
放学路上不在马路上玩耍、踢球、滑滑板: On the way home from school, do not play, kick a ball or skateboard on the road
红灯停，绿灯行，黄灯等: Red stop, green go, yellow wait
过马路走人行横道，先看左右再通过: Cross at the pedestrian crossing and look left and right first
不在马路上追逐打闹: Do not chase or fool around on the road
红停绿行黄灯等，左看右看再前行: Red stop, green go, yellow wait; look left, look right, then go ahead
禁止标志：红色圆圈，表示禁止做某件事，如限速30、禁止行人、禁止停车: Prohibition signs: red circle, meaning "do not do this", e.g. speed limit 30, no pedestrians, no parking
警告标志：黄色三角形，提醒前方有危险，如注意行人、注意儿童、注意信号灯: Warning signs: yellow triangle, warning of danger ahead, e.g. pedestrians, children, traffic lights
指示标志：蓝色圆形（或方形），表示应当这样走，如直行、向右转弯、步行: Information signs: blue circle (or square), meaning "go this way", e.g. straight on, turn right, pedestrians
看到禁止标志不做，看到警告标志减速小心，看到指示标志按规定走: At a prohibition sign, do not do it; at a warning sign, slow down and take care; at an information sign, follow the rule
学校、居民区附近常有“注意儿童”标志，车辆要减速，行人也要小心: Near schools and residential areas there are often "Children" signs: vehicles must slow down and pedestrians must also take care
标志上的数字，如“30”，表示限速每小时30千米: A number on a sign, such as "30", means a speed limit of 30 kilometres per hour
认识常见交通标志，是安全出行的第一步: Knowing common traffic signs is the first step to travelling safely
红圈是禁止，黄三角是警告，蓝圆是指示: Red circle means prohibition, yellow triangle means warning, blue circle means information
看到交通标志要按标志的意思行动: When you see a traffic sign, act according to its meaning
红圈禁、黄角警、蓝圆指: Red circle forbids, yellow angle warns, blue circle directs (红圈禁、黄角警、蓝圆指)
骑车与乘车安全: Safety when cycling and riding in vehicles
按规定，驾驶自行车须年满12周岁，驾驶电动自行车须年满16周岁；不满年龄不上路骑: By regulation, one must be 12 to ride a bicycle and 16 to ride an electric bicycle; under that age, do not ride on the road
骑自行车要靠右，走非机动车道，不逆行、不并排追逐、不撒手、不带人: When cycling, keep to the right in the non-motor-vehicle lane; do not go against traffic, ride side by side chasing each other, take your hands off the handlebars or carry a passenger
骑行时戴头盔更安全；骑电动自行车要戴头盔（许多地方规定必须戴）: Wearing a helmet while cycling is safer; wear one on an electric bicycle (many places require it)
乘小汽车要系好安全带，坐在后排，不把头和手伸出窗外: In a car, fasten your seat belt, sit in the back and do not put your head or hands out of the window
儿童要使用与身高体重相符的儿童安全座椅，不坐副驾驶位: Children should use a child safety seat suited to their height and weight and should not sit in the front passenger seat
乘公交车要排队，车停稳后再上下，不在车内奔跑，抓好扶手: On a bus, queue up, get on and off only after it has stopped fully, do not run inside and hold the handrail
不在车辆行驶时开门；下车前先看后方有没有来车、电动车: Do not open a door while the vehicle is moving; before getting out, check behind for cars and e-bikes
乘车要系好安全带: Fasten your seat belt in a vehicle
骑电动自行车要戴头盔: Wear a helmet on an electric bicycle
不满12周岁不骑自行车上路: Under 12, do not ride a bicycle on the road
骑车靠右戴头盔，乘车系好安全带: Keep right and wear a helmet when cycling; fasten your seat belt in a car
消防安全：火警与逃生: Fire safety: fire alarm and escape
发现火情，立即拨打火警电话119，说清地址、什么东西着火、有没有人被困: If you find a fire, call the fire number 119 at once and say the address, what is burning and whether anyone is trapped
火很小时可以用灭火器；火大了立刻逃生，不要贪恋财物: A very small fire can be put out with an extinguisher; if it is large, escape at once and do not go back for belongings
逃生时用湿毛巾捂住口鼻，弯腰、低姿，贴近地面撤离，因为浓烟往上飘: When escaping, cover your nose and mouth with a wet towel and leave bending low, close to the ground, because thick smoke rises
不乘电梯，走安全通道和楼梯；楼道里烟太浓时回到房间，关紧门，用湿布堵门缝，到窗边: Do not use the lift; take the safety exit and stairs; if the smoke in the corridor is too thick, go back into a room, close the door tightly, block the gap with a wet cloth and call for help at the window
身上着火不要乱跑，就地打滚把火压灭: If your clothes catch fire, do not run; roll on the ground to put it out
不玩火，不玩打火机、鞭炮；发现别的小朋友玩火要劝阻并告诉大人: Do not play with fire, lighters or firecrackers; if other children play with fire, stop them and tell an adult
知道家里和学校的安全出口在哪里，参加逃生演练: Know where the safety exits are at home and at school, and take part in evacuation drills
逃生要用湿毛巾捂口鼻、弯腰低姿: When escaping, cover your nose and mouth with a wet towel and stay low
发生火灾不乘电梯: In a fire, do not use the lift
湿巾捂口鼻，低姿向外跑，电梯不要坐: Wet cloth over nose and mouth, run out low, no lift
常见的是手提式干粉灭火器，用于扑救初起的小火；火势已大要立即撤离: The common type is the portable dry-powder extinguisher, used on small fires just starting; if the fire is already large, leave at once
使用口诀：提、拔、握、压——提起灭火器，拔掉保险销，握住喷管，压下手柄: Mnemonic: lift, pull, hold, press - lift the extinguisher, pull out the safety pin, hold the nozzle, press the handle (提、拔、握、压)
站在上风口，对准火焰根部左右扫射，不对着火苗上方喷: Stand upwind and sweep the base of the flames from side to side; do not spray above the flames
油锅起火：关火后盖上锅盖，不能用水浇: Oil pan fire: turn off the heat and cover with a lid; never pour water on it
电器着火：先切断电源，再灭火；未断电时不要用水: Electrical fire: cut off the power first, then extinguish; do not use water while the power is on
使用前看清压力表指针在绿色区域，灭火器放在明显、方便取用的地方: Before use, check that the pressure gauge needle is in the green zone; keep the extinguisher in a visible, easy-to-reach place
灭火器用完后要重新检查或更换，不能放回原处当作好的: After use, an extinguisher must be rechecked or replaced; do not put it back in place as if it were good
使用灭火器：拔掉保险销，握住喷管，压下手柄: Using an extinguisher: pull out the safety pin, hold the nozzle, press the handle
对准火焰根部扫射: Aim at the base of the flames and sweep
油锅起火用锅盖盖灭，不能浇水: For an oil pan fire, smother it with the lid; never pour water
拔销、握管、压把，瞄准火根扫: Pull the pin, hold the hose, press the handle, aim at the base and sweep (拔销、握管、压把，瞄准火根扫)
不用湿手、湿布碰插头、插座和开关: Do not touch plugs, sockets or switches with wet hands or a wet cloth
不把手指、铁丝、小刀插进插座孔；家里的插座可以装保护盖: Do not push fingers, wire or knives into socket holes; sockets at home can be fitted with protective covers
不拉扯电线，拔插头时抓住插头，不抓电线: Do not pull on cables; when unplugging, hold the plug, not the cable
一个插座上不同时接很多大功率电器，防止过热起火: Do not connect many high-power appliances to one socket at the same time, to prevent overheating and fire
电线破皮、插头发热、冒火花，要立刻告诉大人，不自己修: If a cable is damaged, a plug is hot or sparks appear, tell an adult at once and do not repair it yourself
不在高压线、变压器附近放风筝、玩耍；看到“高压危险”标志要远离: Do not fly kites or play near high-voltage lines or transformers; keep away when you see a "High voltage - danger" sign
有人触电，不要直接用手去拉，先让大人切断电源，再拨打120: If someone is electrocuted, do not pull them with your bare hands; have an adult cut the power first, then call 120
湿手不碰电器和插座: Do not touch appliances or sockets with wet hands
有人触电先切断电源，不直接去拉: If someone is electrocuted, cut the power first and do not pull them directly
电线破损要告诉大人，不自己修: Tell an adult about damaged cables; do not repair them yourself
湿手不碰电，插孔不插东西: No wet hands near electricity; nothing into socket holes
闻到燃气味（臭鸡蛋味），不要开关电灯、电器，不要打电话，不要点火: If you smell gas (like rotten eggs), do not switch lights or appliances on or off, do not use the phone and do not light a flame
立即关闭燃气阀门，打开门窗通风，到室外再拨打燃气公司的抢修电话: Close the gas valve at once, open doors and windows for ventilation, and call the gas company's emergency repair number from outside
必要时拨打119，同时提醒邻居离开: If necessary call 119, and warn the neighbours to leave
用完燃气要关好阀门，煮东西时人不能离开: After using gas, close the valve; do not leave the room while cooking
燃气灶旁不堆放纸张、塑料等易燃物: Do not pile paper, plastic or other flammable items next to the gas cooker
热水器要安装在通风处，洗澡时保持通风，防止一氧化碳中毒: Water heaters must be installed in a ventilated place, and the room kept ventilated when showering, to prevent carbon monoxide poisoning
头晕、恶心、乏力时要立刻到空气新鲜的地方，并告诉大人: If you feel dizzy, sick or weak, go at once to a place with fresh air and tell an adult
闻到燃气味：不开关电器，不点火: If you smell gas: no switching appliances, no flames
关阀门，开窗通风，到室外求助: Close the valve, open windows, get help outside
用燃气热水器要通风: Ventilate when using a gas water heater
关阀、开窗、不点火，出去再打电话: Close the valve, open windows, no flames; phone only once outside
不私自下水游泳: Do not go into the water to swim without permission
不擅自与同学结伴游泳: Do not go swimming with classmates on your own
不在无家长或教师带领时游泳: Do not swim without a parent or teacher leading
不到无安全设施、无救援人员的水域游泳: Do not swim in waters without safety facilities or rescue staff
不到不熟悉的水域游泳: Do not swim in waters you do not know
不熟悉水性的学生不擅自下水施救: Students who cannot swim well must not go into the water to rescue someone
看到有人落水，大声呼喊成年人，拨打120和110，可以扔救生圈、木板、长竿，自己: If you see someone fall into the water, shout loudly for adults, call 120 and 110, and throw a lifebuoy, board or long pole; do not go in yourself
防溺水六不：不私自下水、不结伴游泳、不无人带领游泳、不去无安全设施的水域、不去不: The six don'ts: no swimming without permission, no swimming with friends alone, no swimming without a leader, no waters without safety facilities, no unfamiliar waters, no rescue attempts by entering the water
看到有人落水，大声呼救，不盲目下水: If you see someone fall in, call loudly for help; do not jump in blindly
六个“不”记牢，水边安全才可靠: Remember the six "don'ts" and the waterside will be safe
地震来了怎么办: What to do in an earthquake
在教室里：伏地（蹲下）、遮挡（躲在课桌旁，抓牢桌腿，保护头颈）、避让（远离窗户、: In the classroom: drop (crouch), cover (take shelter beside the desk, hold the desk legs, protect head and neck), keep clear (stay away from windows, lamps and outer walls)
在家里：躲在坚固的桌子下、承重墙的墙角或开间小的卫生间，不躲在窗边和阳台: At home: shelter under a sturdy table, in the corner of a load-bearing wall or in a small bathroom; not by windows or on balconies
震动停止后，有秩序地撤离到空旷地方，不乘电梯，不拥挤: When the shaking stops, evacuate in an orderly way to open ground; do not use the lift and do not crowd
在楼房低层，震动一停可以尽快撤到室外；不要慌张跳楼: On a low floor, you may get outside as soon as the shaking stops; do not panic and jump from a window
在户外：远离高楼、广告牌、电线杆，蹲在空旷处: Outdoors: keep away from tall buildings, billboards and utility poles, and crouch in an open area
在公共场所：不拥向出口，就地蹲下保护头部: In public places: do not rush toward the exits; crouch where you are and protect your head
地震后还可能有余震，不要马上回到楼里；听从老师和大人的安排: Aftershocks may follow; do not go back into the building at once; follow the arrangements of teachers and adults
地震时不乘电梯，不跳楼: In an earthquake, do not use the lift and do not jump from windows
撤离要有序，到空旷处: Evacuate in order, to open ground
先伏地，再遮挡，后避让；电梯不要坐: First drop, then cover, then keep clear; no lift
台风、暴雨、寒潮的预警颜色分四级：蓝色、黄色、橙色、红色: Typhoon, rainstorm and cold-wave warnings have four levels: blue, yellow, orange, red
颜色越深，危险越大：蓝色（一般）、黄色（较重）、橙色（严重）、红色（特别严重）: The darker the colour, the greater the danger: blue (general), yellow (serious), orange (severe), red (extremely severe)
高温、雷电的预警分黄色、橙色、红色三级: Heat and lightning warnings have three levels: yellow, orange, red
收到橙色、红色预警时，尽量待在室内，不外出: When an orange or red warning is received, stay indoors as far as possible and do not go out
可以通过天气预报、手机预警短信和广播了解预警: You can learn about warnings from the weather forecast, mobile phone alert messages and the radio
学校和社区会根据预警发出通知，如停课、停止户外活动: Schools and communities issue notices according to warnings, such as class suspension or halting outdoor activities
听从老师和家长的安排，不自己到危险地方观看: Follow the arrangements of teachers and parents; do not go to dangerous places to watch
预警颜色：蓝、黄、橙、红，越深越危险: Warning colours: blue, yellow, orange, red; the darker, the more dangerous
收到橙色、红色预警要尽量待在室内: When an orange or red warning is received, stay indoors as far as possible
蓝黄橙红，一级比一级严重: Blue, yellow, orange, red: each level more serious than the last
上下楼梯靠右走，慢步轻声，不推挤，不在楼梯上追跑、打闹、嬉戏: On stairs keep right, walk slowly and quietly, do not push, chase, fool around or play
课间在教室、走廊轻声活动，不在走廊里奔跑，不坐在窗台上，不探出窗外: At break, be quiet in classrooms and corridors; do not run in corridors, sit on window sills or lean out of windows
体育课先做准备活动，听从老师的指挥，不做没学过的危险动作: In sports lessons, warm up first, follow the teacher's instructions and do not attempt dangerous moves you have not learned
不带刀具、打火机等危险物品到学校，不把铅笔、剪刀对着别人: Do not bring knives, lighters or other dangerous items to school; do not point pencils or scissors at others
放学按时回家，不在校外逗留，不跟陌生人走: Go home on time after school, do not linger outside school and do not go with strangers
受伤或身体不舒服，马上告诉老师: If you are hurt or feel unwell, tell a teacher at once
发生火灾、地震等紧急情况，听从老师指挥，有序撤离: In a fire, earthquake or other emergency, follow the teacher's instructions and evacuate in an orderly way
上下楼梯靠右走，不推挤: Keep right on stairs; do not push
课间不在走廊追跑，不探出窗外: At break, do not chase in corridors or lean out of windows
受伤或不舒服马上告诉老师: If hurt or unwell, tell a teacher at once
楼梯靠右慢步走，课间活动守规矩: Keep right and walk slowly on stairs; follow the rules at break
吃东西前先洗手；水果、蔬菜要洗干净: Wash your hands before eating; wash fruit and vegetables clean
看清包装上的生产日期和保质期，过期的东西不吃，包装破损、胀袋的不吃: Check the production date and shelf life on the packaging; do not eat expired food or food with damaged or swollen packaging
生的和熟的食物分开放，菜刀和砧板生熟分开；肉、蛋、海鲜要煮熟煮透: Keep raw and cooked food apart, and use separate knives and chopping boards; cook meat, eggs and seafood thoroughly
不吃来路不明的食物，不捡地上的东西吃，不吃陌生人给的东西: Do not eat food of unknown origin, food picked up from the ground or food given by strangers
不吃野生蘑菇和不认识的野果、野菜: Do not eat wild mushrooms or wild fruit and vegetables you do not recognise
不喝生水；少吃油炸食品和含糖饮料，不暴饮暴食: Do not drink untreated water; eat less fried food and sugary drinks and do not overeat
如果吃东西后呕吐、腹泻、肚子疼，告诉大人；有过敏史的食物一口也不吃: If you vomit, have diarrhoea or stomach ache after eating, tell an adult; never eat even a bite of a food you are allergic to
看清保质期，过期食品不吃: Check the shelf life; do not eat expired food
生熟分开，肉蛋要煮熟: Keep raw and cooked apart; cook meat and eggs through
不吃不认识的野果、野蘑菇，不捡地上的东西吃: Do not eat unknown wild fruit or wild mushrooms or food picked up from the ground
先洗手，看日期，生熟分，野味不吃: Wash hands first, check dates, separate raw and cooked, no wild game (先洗手，看日期，生熟分，野味不吃)
防走失与不跟陌生人走: Preventing getting lost, and not going with strangers
记住爸爸妈妈的姓名和电话号码、家庭住址和学校名称: Remember your parents' names and phone numbers, your home address and the name of your school
不跟陌生人走，不吃陌生人给的食物和饮料，不坐陌生人的车: Do not go with strangers, accept food or drink from them or get into their cars
陌生人说“带你去找妈妈”“我给你好东西”，都要拒绝，并告诉大人: If a stranger says "I'll take you to your mum" or "I have something nice for you", refuse and tell an adult
走丢了，不要乱跑，留在原地，向穿制服的人（警察、保安、工作人员）求助，或者请店员: If you get lost, do not run around: stay where you are and ask someone in uniform (police, security, staff) for help, or ask a shop assistant to make an announcement or phone
遇到危险，大声喊“我不认识你”，往人多、亮的地方跑: In danger, shout loudly "I don't know you" and run to a place with many people and light
出门前告诉家人去哪里、和谁一起、几点回来: Before going out, tell your family where you are going, with whom and when you will be back
记住父母的电话和家庭地址: Remember your parents' phone number and your home address
不跟陌生人走，不吃陌生人给的东西: Do not go with strangers; do not accept things from strangers
电话地址要背熟，陌生人说话不理睬: Learn phone numbers and addresses by heart; ignore strangers who speak to you
个人卫生与七步洗手法: Personal hygiene and the seven-step handwashing method
饭前便后、外出回家、打喷嚏咳嗽后都要洗手: Wash your hands before meals, after the toilet, on returning home, and after sneezing or coughing
七步洗手法口诀“内、外、夹、弓、大、立、腕”：洗手掌、洗手背、洗指缝、洗指背、洗: Seven-step mnemonic "palm, back, between, knuckles, thumb, tips, wrist" (内、外、夹、弓、大、立、腕): wash palms, backs, between fingers, finger backs, thumbs, fingertips, wrists
用流动的水和肥皂（洗手液）洗，每一步至少搓15秒，全程不少于20秒: Wash with running water and soap (hand wash); rub at least 15 seconds per step and no less than 20 seconds in total
洗完用干净的毛巾或纸擦干: Dry with a clean towel or paper afterwards
早晚刷牙，饭后漱口，每次刷牙约3分钟: Brush your teeth morning and night, rinse your mouth after meals, and brush for about 3 minutes each time
勤剪指甲，勤洗澡，勤换衣服: Trim fingernails often, bathe often and change clothes often
咳嗽、打喷嚏时用纸巾或手肘遮住口鼻，不随地吐痰: When coughing or sneezing, cover your nose and mouth with a tissue or your elbow; do not spit on the ground

流血较多：用干净的纱布或毛巾直接按压伤口，一直压住，不要松开去看: Heavy bleeding: press directly on the wound with clean gauze or a towel, keep pressing and do not let go to look
把受伤的手或脚抬高，高于心脏的位置，帮助止血: Raise the injured hand or foot above the level of the heart to help stop bleeding
包扎要松紧适度，手指、脚趾要露在外面观察颜色: Bandage with moderate tightness, leaving fingers and toes exposed so their colour can be seen
不要用脏布、泥土、药粉直接涂抹伤口: Do not apply dirty cloth, soil or powder directly to a wound
流鼻血：坐着，身体稍向前倾，用手捏住鼻翼两侧约10分钟，不要仰头: Nosebleed: sit with the body leaning slightly forward and pinch both sides of the nose for about 10 minutes; do not tilt the head back
血止不住、伤口很深或被生锈的东西扎伤，要立即就医，必要时拨打120: If bleeding will not stop, the wound is deep or the injury was caused by something rusty, seek medical care at once and call 120 if necessary
流血时用干净的布直接按压止血: When bleeding, press directly with a clean cloth to stop it
伤口先用清水冲洗: Rinse a wound with clean water first
流鼻血不要仰头: With a nosebleed do not tilt the head back
清水冲，压住血，抬高肢，及时医: Rinse with clean water, press to stop bleeding, raise the limb, see a doctor promptly (清水冲，压住血，抬高肢，及时医)
烫伤的处理：冲、脱、泡、盖、送: Treating burns: cool, remove, soak, cover, send
冲：立即用流动的凉水冲洗烫伤的部位，约15—30分钟: Cool: immediately rinse the burnt area with running cool water for about 15-30 minutes
脱：在冷水中小心地脱去或剪开衣物，不要强行撕扯: Remove: carefully take off or cut away clothing under cold water; do not tear it off by force
泡：继续把伤处放在冷水里浸泡，减轻疼痛: Soak: keep the injured area in cold water to ease the pain
盖：用干净的纱布或毛巾轻轻盖住伤处: Cover: cover the injured area gently with clean gauze or a towel
送：面积较大、水泡较多或在脸部、手部、关节时，要及时送医院: Send: if the area is large, there are many blisters, or the burn is on the face, hands or joints, take the person to hospital promptly
不涂牙膏、酱油、牙粉，不挑破水泡，不用冰块直接敷: Do not apply toothpaste, soy sauce or tooth powder, do not burst blisters and do not apply ice directly
预防烫伤：热水、热汤放在孩子够不到的地方，倒热水时不跑、不闹: To prevent burns, keep hot water and soup out of children's reach, and do not run or fool around when pouring hot water
烫伤口诀：冲、脱、泡、盖、送: Burns mnemonic: cool, remove, soak, cover, send (冲、脱、泡、盖、送)
不涂牙膏、酱油，不挑破水泡: Do not apply toothpaste or soy sauce; do not burst blisters
冲脱泡盖送，五步不能少: Cool, remove, soak, cover, send: do not skip any of the five steps (冲脱泡盖送，五步不能少)
怀疑骨折：不要乱动受伤的部位，尽量保持原来的姿势，也不要揉、按: If a fracture is suspected, do not move the injured part; keep it in its original position as far as possible and do not rub or press it
用木板、硬纸板、树枝等把受伤处固定好，包括骨折处上下两个关节: Immobilise the injury with a board, cardboard, branches or similar, including the joints above and below the fracture
有伤口出血，先止血再固定；不把外露的骨头推回去: If there is a bleeding wound, stop the bleeding first and then immobilise; do not push exposed bone back in
尽快拨打120，或在大人陪同下去医院: Call 120 as soon as possible, or go to hospital accompanied by an adult
扭伤：停止运动，抬高伤处，冷敷（不要立刻热敷、揉搓），可以用弹力绷带包扎: Sprain: stop exercising, raise the injured area and apply cold (not heat or rubbing straight away); an elastic bandage may be used
颈部、背部受伤，不要随意搬动: With a neck or back injury, do not move the person unnecessarily
运动前热身，穿合适的运动鞋，可以预防扭伤: Warming up before exercise and wearing suitable sports shoes can prevent sprains
怀疑骨折不乱动，固定后送医院: With a suspected fracture, do not move; immobilise and go to hospital
扭伤先冷敷，不揉搓: For a sprain, apply cold first and do not rub
颈部背部受伤不搬动: Do not move a neck or back injury
骨折先固定，扭伤先冷敷: Fracture: immobilise first; sprain: cold first
进食时说话、大笑、跑跳，容易把食物呛进气管，造成噎住: Talking, laughing, running or jumping while eating makes it easy to breathe food into the windpipe and choke
噎住的表现：不能说话，不能咳嗽，用手捂住喉咙，脸色发紫: Signs of choking: unable to speak or cough, hands clasped to the throat, face turning blue
一岁以上的儿童和成人：站在伤者身后，一手握拳，拳眼放在肚脐上方，另一手抱住，快速: Children over one year and adults: stand behind the person, make a fist with one hand and place it above the navel, hold it with the other hand and thrust quickly inward and upward until the object comes out
婴儿的方法不同（拍背和按压胸部），应在专业人员指导下学习: The method for infants is different (back blows and chest compressions) and should be learned under professional guidance
同时让人拨打120；如果伤者昏倒，要进行心肺复苏: At the same time have someone call 120; if the person collapses, perform cardiopulmonary resuscitation
自己噎住时，可以把上腹部靠在椅背或桌边，用力冲击: If you are choking yourself, press your upper abdomen against a chair back or table edge and thrust hard
预防：吃东西细嚼慢咽，不边吃边玩，不给小孩吃整颗的果冻、坚果: Prevention: chew food well and eat slowly, do not play while eating, and do not give small children whole jellies or nuts
吃东西时不说笑、不打闹: Do not talk, laugh or fool around while eating
噎住时用海姆立克急救法，并拨打120: If choking, use the Heimlich manoeuvre and call 120
婴儿的急救方法不同: First aid for infants is different
吃饭不说笑，噎住急救快: No talking or laughing at meals; if choking, act fast (吃饭不说笑，噎住急救快)
发现有人溺水，先大声呼救，拨打120和110，不要盲目下水: If you see someone drowning, call out loudly for help, call 120 and 110 and do not jump in blindly
可以用救生圈、木板、绳子、长竿等把落水的人拉上来: Use a lifebuoy, board, rope, long pole or similar to pull the person out of the water
把溺水者救上岸后，让他平卧，清除口鼻中的异物: After bringing the person ashore, lay them flat and clear any foreign matter from the mouth and nose
检查有没有意识和呼吸；没有呼吸，要马上开始心肺复苏，直到救护车到达: Check for consciousness and breathing; if there is no breathing, start cardiopulmonary resuscitation at once and continue until the ambulance arrives
不要让溺水的人头朝下，不要用“倒挂”“压肚子”的方法控水，这样会耽误抢救: Do not hold the person head-down or use "hanging upside down" or "pressing the belly" methods to drain water: they delay rescue
给溺水者保暖，换掉湿衣服: Keep the person warm and change out of wet clothes
即使溺水者醒来，也要到医院检查，因为可能出现肺部的问题: Even if the person wakes up, they must be checked at hospital because lung problems may follow
溺水时先呼救，不盲目下水: If someone is drowning, call for help first; do not jump in blindly
救上岸后没有呼吸要做心肺复苏: If there is no breathing after rescue, do CPR
不倒挂控水，要送医院检查: Do not hang the person upside down to drain water; take them to hospital for checks
溺水先呼救，上岸再急救，医院要检查: Drowning: call for help first, give first aid ashore, and have a hospital check
